sections.title: Launch film
sections.label: Story cuts · tap play for sound
sections.note: Backyard at golden hour to the game after dark, then anywhere. Built story first: each cut is checked on whether a first-time viewer gets the game, the catch, the lights and wants one. Cards mark shots still to come.

items.title: Story cut v0.9
items.rendered: Render PC · RTX 3060 · Blender Cycles on OptiX · 64 samples, hand and crew shots generated
items.tldr: One full round, start to finish, on the beat: the throw, the knock, the dive, the catch, the cheer. First-time viewers rate it 7 of 10 for stopping the scroll, up from 6, and most name the moment the poles light up on the drop.
changes: A real round up front, every shot under two seconds
The rules in one look: KNOCK IT OFF: TWO POINTS. CATCH IT: ZERO.
A big finish: the last throw knocks the glowing bottle off and the crew erupts on the loudest bar

items.title: Story cut v0.8
items.rendered: Render PC · RTX 3060 · Blender Cycles on OptiX · 64 samples, hand and crew shots generated
items.tldr: Real people and a real catch. Friends play in silhouette at sunset and under the lit poles, and the glowing bottle now drops into the hands. 11 of 12 first-time viewers named that night catch as the moment they remember.
changes: One bottle everywhere, frosted by day and glowing from inside at night
A crew in silhouette: a diving catch opens the film, a sunset high-five, the crew cheering under the lit poles
The night is readable: a dark wide before the lights, then the lit set with the crew; both catches move

items.title: Story cut v0.7
items.rendered: Render PC · RTX 3060 · Blender Cycles on OptiX · 64 samples, hand shots generated
items.tldr: No text cards left: every shot is picture. Hand shots now show the throw, the golden-hour catch and the night catch with the glowing bottle. A close-up of the bottle on the pole after the opening wide helped first-time viewers most.
changes: The three cards are now hand shots: the release, a catch in low sun, two hands closing round the lit bottle at night
Golden-hour close-up of the bottle on the pole top right after the opening wide
Starts two bars earlier in the song; knock-off to end card keeps its timing

items.title: Story cut v0.4
items.rendered: Render PC · RTX 3060 · Blender Cycles on OptiX · 64 samples
items.tldr: First story-first cut. Golden-hour backyard opening with the real knock, lights on at the drop, beach turn and win. Release and catch shots are still cards.
changes: New golden-hour backyard: wide, slow-motion knock, sunset
Knock physics measured against real slow-motion footage
Story checked by a cold viewer panel: 8.2 of 10

items.tldr: Re-render of the current look with no new kept changes.

items.title: Draft v0.4
items.rendered: Render PC · RTX 3060 · Blender Cycles on OptiX · 128 samples
items.tldr: 6 look changes kept by the look-dev loop (cycles C001 to C011).
changes: The distant headland now has a broken, ridged skyline instead of a smooth dome.
The lit bottles glow with a hot near-white core and team colour at the edges, like a real camera sees them.
The sunlit tube in the golden-hour close-up reads round and glowing, not flat.
The driftwood seats round the fire are weathered logs with grain, cracks and broken ends.
The hoodie left on a seat drapes over the log like real cloth.
The sandals by the fire are real flip-flops, not blocks.

items.title: Draft v0.3
items.rendered: Mac mini M4 · Blender Cycles on Metal · 32 samples
items.tldr: First look pass. Director score up from 5.6 to 6.7.
changes: Golden hour sits lower and warmer, with a real orange sun
Driftwood and beach debris added along the sand
Discs are bigger and read in flight
Campfire lights the friends shot instead of leaving it near black
The bottle's colour holds through the first throw
PICK YOUR LIGHT SHOW. now clears the rainbow pole

items.title: Draft v0.2
items.rendered: Mac mini M4 · Blender Cycles on Metal · 32 samples
items.tldr: Four review fixes on the same timing as v0.1.
changes: Bottle no longer picks up a tint from a stray light
End card uses the rainbow logo with a white wordmark
Camp shots lose their orange cast
PICK YOUR LIGHT SHOW. moved clear of the phone
